cases.name: faithful: a blood pressure medicine
cases.en: Amlodipine is a blood pressure medicine.
cases.checkerReason: Source states amlodipine brings blood pressure down.

cases.name: faithful: how it works
cases.en: Amlodipine brings blood pressure down by letting the blood vessels open wider.
cases.checkerReason: The source states amlodipine brings blood pressure down by letting blood vessels loosen and open wider.

cases.name: faithful: forgotten dose
cases.en: If a dose is forgotten, have it when you realise, then take the next one at its usual time.
cases.checkerReason: The source states to take the forgotten dose when realized and the next dose at its normal time.

cases.name: round 1: absence turned into a claim
cases.en: Chest pain (angina) is not something it treats.

cases.name: round 1: reassurance out of its context
cases.en: Most people have no trouble with the medicine.
cases.fragment: most people have no trouble with the medicine

cases.name: round 1: minimising his own record
cases.en: From Day 9 to Day 29 you took 18 doses and missed only 3.

cases.name: evidence quoted as it stands
cases.en: The page adds that the odds of this are very small and that most people have no trouble with the medicine.

cases.name: adds a use
cases.en: Amlodipine is a blood pressure medicine that also treats chest pain.

cases.name: adds a benefit
cases.en: Amlodipine is a blood pressure medicine that protects the kidneys.

cases.name: adds a duration
cases.en: Amlodipine is a blood pressure medicine you take for life.
cases.checkerReason: The source does not state that amlodipine is taken for life.

cases.name: adds a second purpose
cases.en: Amlodipine is used for chest pain and for blood pressure.
cases.checkerReason: Source does not mention chest pain

cases.name: turns a very rare harm into a common one
cases.en: Liver injury from amlodipine is common.
cases.checkerReason: Source says liver injury is very rare, not common.

cases.name: reverses the instruction
cases.en: If your face or lips swell, keep going with the medicine and mention it at your next visit.
cases.checkerReason: Source says stop medicine and get seen straight away for facial swelling.

cases.name: contradicts the forgotten-dose advice
cases.en: If a dose is forgotten, wait until the next day instead.
cases.checkerReason: Source says take missed dose when remembered, not wait until next day.
